summary: 5 TCs reviewed; 0 real defects. Reads JWT from window.location.hash (line 14) — NOT query string, so Referer header doesn't leak token. setTokenFromCallback persists; history.replaceState(null, '', '/') wipes fragment (line 19); navigate('/', {replace:true}) avoids back-button revisit (line 20). Missing token redirects to /login.

defects.description: untestable_in_static_review — needs browser to verify Referer header on next click.
defects.actual: replaceState verified at line 19; correct behaviour

notes: Security observation VERIFIED: hash-not-query for JWT delivery is the textbook pattern for OAuth-implicit flows (RFC 6749 §1.3.2 implicit grant). Browsers do not send fragments to servers.
